description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ballapana, Udabage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalla District - Cad. Map No. 61008 (24/0265).
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Plot 1:13, Block 04) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns property ownership registration and land title settlement matters.
